name: welcome-offer-signup
title: Welcome offer signup
description: Trade an email for a first-order discount and reveal the code in place, with a copy button and the terms.
docs: Pass offer (a title, a description and the terms as a list), onSubmit and action. onSubmit receives the address and resolves with the code, or with { code, returning: true } for an address that signed up before, which reads Welcome back and hands the same code over again. The code is not in the page until that response arrives, so view source and crawlers get nothing; defaultResult is the one way to start on a code, for a visitor who is meant to have it. The consent line is required and sits beside the button, and the terms show under the form as one line and next to the code as a list. The code is a copy field that says Copied in words. action is the button under the code: an href makes it a link, otherwise it calls onClick, and its text is Start shopping unless you set a label. The result takes focus so a screen reader reads it. labels translates every fixed word.
